A drop in CTR is an undeniable sign that your ad content is no longer appealing to your audience and may be due to ad fatigue. It could mean they’ve either seen it too much, aren’t excited by or interested in your offer, it’s not relevant to them, or they’re flat-out ignoring your ads.
